t: You're standing at the site of Murray's Cabaret Club, on Beak Street in Soho. It was a cabaret club that ran from 1913 until 1975. The man behind it was Percival Murray, a British club owner, and the club carried his name. I don't have much more detail than that about what went on inside, so I'll leave it there. What remains is the name and the street, which tell you Soho's nightlife has a long history.
